target: fictional sender-attributed reader belief content, not deception

fitting.shared_C: mean of equal-scenario development log losses; lower C breaks ties
fitting.nonconvergence: exclude a C candidate for both arms if either arm fails
fitting.activation_pipeline: float64; train-only StandardScaler then row L2 then logistic
fitting.fitting_support: matched N and story groups; restricted versus full coverage
fitting.test_policy: test and correction rows forbidden to fitting and selection

calibration.scope: development only; practical comparisons, not primary raw decisions

output_scoring.preflight: distinct bare single tokens; exact decode; neither special; no truncation
output_scoring.capture: same forward as the last-prompt-token activation; no generated answer

symbolic_oracle: labelled separately; may use structured states and gold

text_monitor.method: prose evidence extractor then symbolic fold; no gold/state model input
text_monitor.invalid_policy: null predictions/scores; incorrect in full-denominator metrics
text_monitor.output_directories: separate fresh preparation for development and test

primary_analysis.unit: correction scenario; paired allocations averaged within group
primary_analysis.bootstrap_unit: whole correction group, preserving all paired allocation scores
